classification.scope: Repository-only offline four-Publication numeric tolerance evidence contract.

implemented_contract: Numeric policies bind dataset, version, rule, field, unit and exact absolute/relative thresholds with content identities.
Decimal input and computed deviations preserve large exact values, use plain notation and compare relative bounds without rounded division.
The parser accepts only strict UTF-8 select_only JSON and rejects duplicate keys and non-finite constants.
All four current Publications bind exact members, P2 policy identity, current UUID5, publication hash, unique fact identities and member evidence/quality/time validity.
Each Publication asset set recomputes the canonical active-a-share universe hash; covered_asset_count is independent from member_count.
Every Publication member and governed field appears exactly once with its canonical unit.
Reference and observed snapshot hashes are recomputed from normalized compared values and source identity.
The operational recorder reads only the repository numeric policy registry and performs no database, provider or network operation.
Local writes are explicit, append-only and content-addressed; missing or conflicting sidecars fail closed.
